watch.summary: The streamer plays Rocket League and tempts fate by declaring that the opposing team cannot score two goals in 16 seconds.

beats.what: Opponent scores a goal to make the score 3-1 with 17 seconds left.
Streamer confidently says there is no way they score two goals in 16 seconds.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Surely there's no way they score two more goals in 16 seconds.
watch.why: The streamer delivers a classic jinx setup by claiming the opponent can't score in time. However, the clip ends before any payoff or fast counter-goal occurs, leaving the joke incomplete.
